data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 resolves the question correctly only by smuggling in an extra causal mechanism — an exclusive-bundle constraint ('pencils are sold exclusively in bundles of 7') — that the problem never states. The actual problem says only '7 for $2,' which is compatible with a uniform unit rate. By making its $6 answer contingent on a discrete-composite-SKU interpretation, SRC_002 substitutes an unverified causal model (exclusive bundles) for the straightforward proportional reasoning the problem demands. Its own counterconditions concede the bundle exclusivity may be false, so its stated mechanism is not the one the problem licenses.
